title: ModelLifecycleRequest
description: An agent asking the operator to make a model ready on a server, or to release it, over NATS request and reply on kubemoot.server.model.<server>. The operator's engine adapter carries it out. Only engines that put models to sleep (vLLM) take it; Ollama loads on demand and is never asked.

action.description: ready wakes the model's server (putting the awake one on the same accelerator to sleep first); release puts it to sleep.

model.description: The model, by the name the server serves it under.

agent.description: The agent asking, for the operator's log.

ticketId.description: The placement ticket of the call the request is made for, on a ready request. While the operator drains a model before putting it to sleep it counts the tickets held for that model as work it must wait for, except those whose call is itself waiting for the switch; this names which ticket that is. Absent when the request is not made for a placed call.
